prompts.cedar: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square seamless game material BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture for weathered cedar garden furniture, to be mapped onto 3D timber in Blender. Fill every pixel edge-to-edge with the surface of a SINGLE continuous piece of honey-grey brown cedar wood, fine longitudinal wood fibres running vertically, natural subtle narrow growth rings, sparse small knots, slight silver weathering and tiny grain cracks. Orthographic scan, physically credible wood grain, restrained colour variation. Uniform diffuse unlit appearance: absolutely NO cast shadows, highlights, ambient occlusion, perspective, bevels, plank borders, objects, text, logos, frames or watermarks. All four edges should tile seamlessly. This is a raw surface texture, not a picture of furniture. Fine realistic microdetail, usable at a physical scale of approximately 50 cm wide.
prompts.stone: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square game material BASE COLOR / ALBEDO for old warm pale limestone. Edge-to-edge flat orthographic scan of ONE continuous stone surface, not a wall made of blocks: finely pitted chalky warm beige-grey limestone, irregular tiny pores and occasional delicate mineral seams, slightly mottled cream and cool grey grains, sparse subtle earth stains. Soft natural restrained colour variation, no large cracks. Physically credible fine microdetail at approximately 70 cm real-world width. Uniform diffuse unlit surface with no highlights, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, perspective, masonry joints, objects, text, logos, frames or watermarks. Seamless tile on all four edges. A material texture only, not an object render.
prompts.fur: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square neutral short mammal fur BASE COLOR / ALBEDO surface texture for UV mapping game animals in Blender. Fill entire canvas with dense, fine, short grey-beige animal underfur with delicate individual tapered guard hairs, softly layered, naturally varied but all primarily flowing from top to bottom. Fur is fine like a short-haired cat or wombat coat, not wool, shaggy hair, carpet, wood grain, long combed locks or skin. Neutral pale taupe-grey palette so it can be tinted differently per species. Close orthographic material scan, approximately 12 cm real-world width. Uniform unlit diffuse lighting without baked shadows, glare, ambient occlusion or highlights. NO animal outline, face, limbs, environment, words, grid, labels, frames or watermarks. Edges tile seamlessly on all four sides. Fine realistic hair detail, restrained low-frequency contrast.
prompts.feather: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square feather texture for UV mapping one bird primary feather 3D mesh in Blender. Fill entire image rectangle with the vane of ONE neutral warm grey flight feather, straight slim pale rachis running perfectly vertically along x=50% from bottom to top, fine parallel interlocking feather barbs angling from central shaft towards the edges, left half slightly narrower asymmetrically than right. Feather vane texture fills canvas edge to edge; do not show external feather outline or background. Microscopic realistic structure with very restrained colour variation, no fluffy fur. Neutral pale grey so it can be tinted for different bird plumage. Flat orthographic scan with uniform unlit diffuse appearance, NO baked highlights, cast shadows, dark occlusion, perspective, object scene, text, frames, labels or watermarks. It will be mapped over an actual feather-shaped 3D mesh; only provide the feather surface.
prompts.card: Asset type: photorealistic game HAIR CARD texture on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, square canvas. One single small flat fan-shaped tuft of fine straight animal guard hairs, all pale neutral grey-beige, tightly rooted in a dense horizontal base at bottom centre (x 35% to 65%, y 92%) and spreading upward and slightly outwards toward tapering individual tips (top tips reach y 7%, widest spread x 16% to 84%). About 50 fine individual strands with subtly varied lengths, layered fine wisps at edges. Fur strands primarily vertical; short mammal fur, not human hairstyle, not feather, not grass. Flat orthographic unlit texture scan, realistic natural tapered hairs with subtle colour variance, no cast shadow, no highlight, NO background colour, no grid, no chequerboard drawn into pixels, no letters, no labels, no borders, no scene. Transparent gaps between loose hairs and completely transparent canvas outside the tuft. This texture will be alpha-clipped on tiny bent 3D strips to provide a furry animal silhouette.
prompts.contour: Asset type: photorealistic seamless square bird CONTOUR PLUMAGE base-colour texture for a 3D game. Extreme-close flat orthographic unlit scan of a dense naturally smooth layer of many tiny overlapping short bird body contour feathers, all feathers flow from top towards bottom. Pale neutral grey-beige so it can be tinted by species. Fine interlocking hairlike feather barbs with soft shallow layered tips, inconspicuous central shafts, little tufts of fine down near some lower tips. This is the smooth fine coat of a bird's breast or back, not wing feathers, not flight feathers, not scales, not fur, not chevrons. Approximately 12 cm of real surface fills entire square. Texture edge-to-edge and tileable on all four sides. Subtle detail and colour variation, no baked dark shadows, no ambient occlusion, no glare or specular highlight, no perspective, no animal face, no body outline, no background, no grid, labels, words, borders, watermark or framing.
prompts.fine_fur: Use case: photorealistic game texture. Create ONE sparse vertical mammal hair strand cluster on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square image. This is an alpha cutout for a narrow curved fur card, NOT an illustration of a fluffy patch. Show only 18 to 24 individual very fine pale neutral grey hairs growing from a narrow small base near the bottom center and extending mostly straight upward with slight natural curvature. Hairs have different lengths and needle-fine tapering tips. Clearly separated strands with substantial transparent air gaps along their full length; transparent area should cover at least 75 percent of the canvas. The cluster occupies the middle 65 percent of width and 90 percent of height. No broad solid undercoat, no bush, no feather, no leaf, no fan shape, no dense filled mass, no frame, no drop shadow, no text, no background colour or checkerboard. Even diffuse light, neutral pigment, no baked highlights. High resolution crisp realistic hair silhouette and genuine alpha between hairs.
